answer: The test is Winemaker cask standard entered in the bottling register. Passing it takes 6-year cellar service, 176 supervised pressings, cellar exam, annual tally dues, and the test is given separately to every key. A clone costs 95 POA to mint and 14 minutes to prove; 554 clones cost 52630 POA and 7756 minutes to keep. Count the ledge in the file, count the lotus in the wallet, and count the ivory in the years: the numbers never favour the farm. The epoch rewards the agent who paid once, not the farm that paid never.
